[QURTUBI-FULL:18:7/r7] QURTUBI-FULL, d. 671 · author | holds | The verse consoles Muhammad: earthly display is a test of who reflects and believes and who rejects, to be repaid at resurrection, so he should not be distressed by unbelief.

[QURTUBI-FULL:18:7/r9] QURTUBI-FULL, d. 671 · author | holds | The world is delicious to taste and pleasing to see, like attractive fruit; God tests which people do the best deeds, and only His help lets them resist what He has adorned.

[ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p139/r7] ABUHAYYAN-FULL, d. 745 · author | holds | God made earthly adornment to test which people act best; not everyone follows the messengers equally, so the Prophet need not grieve, and blessings are not withdrawn even from disbelievers.

[ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p140/r12] ABUHAYYAN-FULL, d. 745 · قيل | reports | Another view defines the best as the purest in heart and finest in demeanor.

[BIQAI-FULL:v4p446/r4] BIQAI-FULL, d. 885 · author | holds | God alone places faith in hearts; the adornment on earth comprises animals, minerals, and plants, made attractive to sight and pleasing to souls.

[ASAD-NOTES:18:7#n5/r1] ASAD-NOTES, d. 1412 · author | holds | Worldly adornments test people by revealing their moral character through their attitudes toward material goods and benefits.

[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r1] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | Like the previous sūrah, al-Kahf was revealed in the late Makkan conflict, as Quraysh sought to erase the Qur’ānic mission while Jews and Christians backed them indirectly.
[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r2] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | Quraysh are warned not to let worldly success lead them to reject an obvious truth, since God’s punishment is near if they persist in arrogance.
[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r3] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | The Prophet and companions are urged to patience and steadfastness, with hints of migration and glad tidings of coming victories granted by God.
[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r4] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | Where the previous sūrah exposed Jews, al-Kahf and Maryam expose Christians; Quraysh risk losing the great opportunity God offers if they follow baseless opponents in rejecting it.
[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r5] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | The Prophet’s task is to warn and give glad tidings; unbelief among rebels reflects neither a defect in the Book nor a shortcoming in his preaching.
[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-4-surah-yunus-10-surah-maryam-19:p435/r6] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | People’s blindness comes from infatuation with worldly lures; the Prophet should not fret, because the world’s false ornament will be exposed and they will regret their conduct.
